text:
maria: quick alert  PTQ int8 canary (raven-lite-int8) is showing an uptick in structured-output parse failures for funcall JSONs. not catastrophic but noticeable.

ajay: numbers?

maria: baseline fp32 parse_success ~99.1%. int8 canary (n=3k) parse_success ~93.6%. funcall_mismatch rose from 0.6% -> 2.9%. median latency improved ~25ms.

sam: any pattern on sequence length or streaming behavior?

maria: digging: higher failure concentration for outputs >380 tokens. two failure modes: truncated suffix (missing closing ]) and extra punctuation (dangling comma). streaming cutoffs in the int8 path look correlated.

jess: did the replay with exact kv-prefix lengths reproduce?

maria: yes. replay (same prompts, kv-prefix distribution) shows similar failure delta. int8 emits truncated fragments ~1.4% and malformed punctuation ~0.9% of traces.

linh: hypothesis: quantized kernels alter the buffer flush timing during streaming which occasionally drops 1-2 tokens at tail. also slight change in logit smoothing could cause different punctuation.

ajay: what's our fallback behavior currently? repair heuristics in the agent?

maria: agent local-repair recovers ~40% of parse failures but sometimes changes argument shapes. when repair succeeds it adds ~120-200ms. not acceptable for tight p95 SLAs.

sam: idea: add a short deterministic warm prefix (4 or 10 tokens) before prompting the model on int8 canary traffic to stabilize kv alignment. ran quick microbenchmarks: 10-token warmstart raised parse_success 93.6% -> 96.4% on the sample set.

jess: cost?

sam: 10-token warmstart adds ~4ms median, ~12ms p95. still net latency win vs fp32.

linh: also want a smarter retry flow: on parse failure try 1) local heuristics 2) a focused suffix-retry prompt: "The last response was cut off. Reply ONLY with the missing JSON suffix to complete the previous object." max_new_tokens=120 temp=0.0. only accept if parsed and schema-validation passes.

ajay: need guards: if repaired args differ significantly from original (say >12% token edit distance) mark as mismatch and escalate. don't auto-accept.

maria: agreed. plus we should record original+repaired pair and compute token-edit-distance and schema-diff hash. add a metric repair_accept_rate and repair_semantic_delta_pct.

ci-bot: [canary-run] 4161230000: launched 1% canary for raven-lite-int8 at 2026-03-21T17:22:00Z

jess: rollout proposal: 1% with warmstart=10 and retry_flow=[local_repair,suffix_retry], collect 24h. promotion criteria: schema_success >= 97.0% and funcall_mismatch < 1.0% and no semantic_mismatch alerts.

maria: added dashboard tiles: schema_success, parse_success, funcall_mismatch, repair_attempt_rate, repair_accept_rate, repair_latency_p95, kv_warmness_pct.

linh: I'll add a kv-warmness probe (proxy = fraction of requests that use KV prefix within first 40 tokens). instrument before/after warmstart.

sam: alternative: a non-visible control-token sentinel appended after JSON like "\n<EOT_JSON>\n" but we avoid changing downstream logs. prefer warmstart + suffix-retry first.

ajay: long-term: if warmstart is necessary we should bake it into quant-onboard docs and add a regression test in CI: new model onboarding fails if parse_success for a canonical structured-output harness drops by >1.5% vs reference.

maria: will update the onboarding playbook and add INF-1482 to track (int8 warmstart + suffix-retry rollout).

jess: I'll push a tiny orchestrator change to enable warmstart toggle and retry_flow params for canaries. can drive rollout.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary-config patched: warmstart_tokens=10, retry_flow=[local_repair,suffix_retry], sample_rate=0.01 by jess at 2026-03-21T17:23:15Z

maria: after 45m: parse_success improved 93.6% -> 96.2%. repair_accept_rate ~34% of failures, funcall_mismatch down to 1.7%. p95 latency up ~9ms.

linh: promising. running a 10k eval harness (covering seq-lens up to 1200 tokens) and will post CSV with breakdowns.

ajay: keep an eye on semantic_mismatch alerts and token-edit-distance distribution.

sam: follow-ups: jess runs 24h canary and publishes plots; linh runs 10k harness; ajay drafts onboarding CI rule; maria sets repair acceptance thresholds and integrates schema-guard checks.

jess: will post canary summary in #eng-ml tomorrow.

ci-bot: [alert] 4161230099: canary repair sample logging hit retention warning  consider pruning or increasing quota.

ajay: linh please prioritize storing failures+repaired pairs and sample 5% of successes.

linh: will keep all failures and repaired bundles, sample 5% of successful parses for baseline.

maria: recording action items in INF-1482 (int8 warmstart + suffix-retry + quant-onboard updates). thanks team.
